item.title: Hyogo Nature: Mt. Rokko, Awaji Island & Coastal Trails
item.description: Hyogo Prefecture stretches across one of Japan’s most geographically diverse corridors, running from the Pacific-facing shores of the Seto Inland Sea all the way north to the dramatic cliffs and hidden beaches of the Sea of Japan coast. Between these two edges lies an interior of forested mountains, river valleys, and historic castle towns. Few Japanese prefectures can offer a visitor alpine wildflower meadows, oceanic tidal whirlpools, fishing village seascapes, and terraced rural farmland within a single day’s travel.
